content.text:
The image shows four separate carbon monoxide units, each drawn as C⁻≡O⁺, plus a nickel atom (Ni). No bonds connect them, so this is nickel tetracarbonyl drawn as disconnected fragments.

Each CO unit is written as [C-]#[O+]. The fragments are separated by dots, and Ni is a neutral atom.

SMILES: [C-]#[O+].[C-]#[O+].[C-]#[O+].[C-]#[O+].[Ni]
